title: Valid GitHub Actions context for governed generated refresh dispatch

phases.objective: Allow GitHub to register and plan the trusted issue-comment dispatcher by removing the unavailable jobs-level runner.temp expression while preserving its exact-head, structured-evidence, and read-only repository boundary.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository operator and GitHub Actions workflow planner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted /refresh-generated-artifacts <exact-sha> command on an open same-repository pull request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub plans the trusted default-branch dispatcher, validates the exact PR head and explicit label, emits bounded canonical dispatch evidence, and delegates only the registered exact-head writer without direct repository mutation.
steps: Reject jobs-level use of the runner context before a runner exists.
Use one stable repository-relative evidence directory shared by report creation, upload, direct publication, and enforcement.
Resolve the exact same-repository open pull request and bind the typed command SHA to its current head.
Require the generated-artifact-refresh label and reject protected branches.
Dispatch the registered writer with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Publish mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 directly from trusted main before enforcing the result.
assertions: The workflow is issue_comment and workflow_dispatch only, with no push or pull-request trigger.
Permissions remain actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read, with no contents:write.
The dispatcher checks out trusted main with persist-credentials:false and never checks out candidate code.
Exact head, same-repository identity, explicit label, protected-branch rejection, and typed confirmation remain enforced.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and secrets_included remains false.
No migration, deployment, Production mutation, provider call, credential access, external publication, direct contents write, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe one trusted exact-head issue-comment command publish a passed dispatch report and start the registered writer on a non-protected work branch.
Exercise stale heads, missing labels, ambiguous pull requests, malformed commands, dispatch rejection, repeated commands, and publisher failure without consulting Job logs.
This repository automation repair does not execute a live provider or deployment canary.
The dispatcher grants no migration, runtime, provider, credential, deployment, or Production authority.
